messages:
Sofia Patel: Hey support team — onboarding for a new customer 'HorizonData' just finished but they report their API requests failing. Console shows: "No API key found for project horizon-data-prod". Can someone look into provisioning?

Camila R.: I pulled the onboarding job logs. It looks like the key creation step errored with "scope_mismatch: requested scopes not allowed for customer tier" in one run, but earlier attempts show a different failure: "validation failed: project_owner not set".

Arjun Gupta: Do we have their plan/commit? If they requested dedicated/reserved capacity, scope restrictions might apply. What exact stack trace do you have?

Sofia Patel: Paste of the provisioning snippet from the console:
```
provisioner.createKey(project=horizon-data-prod)
-> validate(project.owner_id) FAILED: None
-> abort, no key created
```

Camila R.: Yup — owner_id is null. Looks like the SSO mapping didn't populate the owner attribute on org creation. SAML assertion for their IdP didn't match our expected claim name.

Mike (Support): For immediate customer unblock I can create a temporary scoped API key and bind it to the project manually. Want me to do that and DM the key to Sofia? We'll mark TTL 24h.

Sofia Patel: Please, yes. We need something while eng fixes the provisioning. Also can you confirm the minimal scopes we should grant?

Camila R.: Minimal safe scopes: inference:generate, embeddings:create. Do not grant admin:project or billing scopes.

Arjun Gupta: Also note earlier error about scope_mismatch — that tends to happen if the customer's org tier is set to free but they requested paid-only scopes. We'll verify org billing tier after unblocking.

Mike (Support): Created temp key (redacted in channel). Scopes: [inference:generate, embeddings:create]. TTL set to 24h. Sent to Sofia via DM. Marked as support-temp; added note to incident tracker.

Sofia Patel: Customer confirmed they can call /v1/embeddings with the temp key. Thanks. Camila — can you share repro steps so we can close the loop and deploy a fix?

Camila R.: Repro steps I used: take sample SAML assertion from the customer's IdP (they used Okta), run our onboarding lambda locally with that assertion. Onboarding returned org record with owner_id=null. Provisioner sees null owner and refuses key creation. Quick fix: fallback to claim 'email' if 'user.principalName' missing. I'll prepare a small patch and add an e2e test that runs onboarding+provisioning end-to-end with a mocked SAML payload.

provision-bot: scheduled re-run of onboarding job for org horizon-data-prod at 1768880140

Camila R.: Re-run is executing now. I'll watch logs. If owner_id becomes populated the provisioner should create the key and bind it.

Sofia Patel: Mike — please log the temp key in INC and ensure a revocation task is queued once the real key is present.

Mike (Support): Done. Incident INC-2026-874 created. Temp key set to auto-revoke after 24h or on successful repro.

Camila R.: Re-run succeeded at 1768880141 — key created and bound to horizon-data-prod. Notifying the customer now. I'll open a PR with the SSO mapping fallback and add the e2e test.

Sofia Patel: Great work, team. Please add a short postmortem note to the onboarding docs and tag eng-identity to review claim mappings for common IdPs. :thumbsup:
